detail: All console users have MFA enrolled.
remediation: Enforce MFA for all console users via the Identity policy 'mfa-totp' and group policy.

check_title: User holds long-lived API signing keys
detail: User has 2 long-lived API signing key(s).
remediation: Use instance principals / resource principals and rotate keys regularly.

check_title: IAM policy grants broad manage all-resources
detail: Policy contains statements granting manage all-resources (tenancy/root compartment).
remediation: Scope policies to compartments and specific resource-types; audit with Policy Analyzer.

detail: Bucket is publicly readable (public access type: ObjectRead).
remediation: Set public access type to NoPublicAccess and review bucket policies.

detail: Bucket versioning is disabled.
remediation: Enable versioning on buckets holding mutable data.

check_title: Bucket not using customer-managed encryption key
detail: Bucket uses Oracle-managed keys, not a Vault customer key.
remediation: Encrypt buckets with a Vault-managed key where required.

check_title: Security list exposes management ports to the internet
detail: Security list exposes ports [22, 443] to 0.0.0.0/0.
remediation: Restrict security list ingress to trusted CIDRs; use OCI Bastion service for SSH.

check_title: NSG allows open ingress to management ports
detail: NSG contains an ingress rule open to 0.0.0.0/0 on management ports.
remediation: Scope NSG ingress rules to specific source CIDRs and ports.

check_title: Volume not encrypted with customer-managed key
detail: Block volume uses Oracle-managed encryption keys, not a customer-managed Vault key.
remediation: Encrypt volumes with a Vault customer key where compliance requires it.

check_title: Autonomous Database uses a public endpoint
detail: Autonomous Database uses a public endpoint.
remediation: Disable public access and use private endpoints / private DNS.

check_title: ADB not using customer-managed encryption key
detail: ADB uses Oracle-managed keys (not customer-managed Vault keys).
remediation: Associate a Vault master key with the database.

detail: Vault key rotation is disabled (or no rotation schedule).
remediation: Enable key rotation (min 90 days, or use versioned keys).

detail: Cloud Guard is enabled with a target in the tenancy.
remediation: Enable Cloud Guard with a tenancy-level target and responder rules.

detail: VCN flow logging is not enabled on this subnet.
remediation: Enable flow logs on all subnets and ship to a log group.

detail: No IAM policy enforces MFA; console and API access can proceed without it.
remediation: Add an identity policy enforcing MFA for all users/groups.

check_title: IAM policy scoped to tenancy root
detail: Policy statement is scoped to the tenancy root compartment - applies to every compartment.
remediation: Scope policies to compartments and specific resource-types.

check_title: NSG not referenced by any resource
detail: NSG is not referenced by any resource; it provides no protection.
remediation: Attach the NSG to the intended resources or delete it.

detail: Bucket has 3 active pre-authenticated request(s) - time-bound URLs that bypass IAM.
remediation: List and revoke unused PARs; prefer signed URLs issued on demand.

detail: Enabled internet gateway provides direct public routing for the VCN.
remediation: Disable internet gateways not required and route egress through NAT.

detail: Enabled internet gateway provides direct public routing for the VCN.
remediation: Disable internet gateways not required and route egress through NAT.

detail: Load balancer has no listener with SSL/TLS; traffic is plaintext.
remediation: Terminate TLS on all listeners and redirect HTTP to HTTPS.

detail: Load balancer has a public IP; consider private LB behind a WAF/bastion.
remediation: Use private load balancers behind WAF where possible.

detail: Load balancer has a public IP; consider private LB behind a WAF/bastion.
remediation: Use private load balancers behind WAF where possible.

detail: Volume has no backups configured; data loss cannot be recovered.
remediation: Configure automatic or policy-based backups for all volumes.

detail: No Bastion service; SSH/RDP to compute is likely exposed via public ingress.
remediation: Deploy the Bastion service and remove public management ingress.

detail: Autonomous Data Guard is not enabled; no cross-region failover for the database.
remediation: Enable Autonomous Data Guard for production databases.

check_title: No Cloud Guard detector recipes active
detail: Cloud Guard has 2 detector recipe(s) active.
remediation: Enable managed detector recipes and attach them to targets.

check_title: File system not encrypted with customer-managed key
detail: File system uses Oracle-managed keys, not a Vault customer key.
remediation: Associate a Vault master key with the file system.

detail: File system has no snapshots; data cannot be rolled back.
remediation: Enable automatic snapshots on file systems.

check_title: OS Management Service not managing instances
detail: No instances are managed by OS Management Service; patch and vulnerability compliance is not tracked.
remediation: Onboard instances to OS Management Service.

detail: Bucket has no lifecycle policy; stale objects accumulate.
remediation: Define a lifecycle policy to expire/archive objects.

detail: Volume has no cross-region replica; data is lost if the region fails.
remediation: Create cross-region volume replicas for critical volumes.

detail: Route table sends 0.0.0.0/0 to an internet gateway; workloads get direct public egress.
remediation: Route default traffic via NAT gateway and restrict IGW routes.

detail: A NAT gateway provides controlled egress.
remediation: Deploy a NAT gateway and route egress through it.

detail: No OSMS managed instance groups; instances have no scheduled patch baseline.
remediation: Create OSMS managed instance groups and attach patch baselines.

detail: Audit log retention is 60 days (< 90); forensic history is lost too early.
remediation: Raise audit retention period to >= 90 days.

detail: Backup retention is 3 days (< 7); recovery options are limited.
remediation: Set backup retention to at least 7 days.

detail: 2 pre-authenticated request(s) have no expiration; temporary access never expires.
remediation: Set an expiration on every pre-authenticated request.

check_title: OCI API key older than 90 days
detail: API key is 240 days old (> 90); rotate to limit leaked-key blast radius.
remediation: Rotate user API keys every 90 days.

detail: Table has no throughput limits; a traffic spike can drive unbounded cost.
remediation: Define max read/write throughput on every NoSQL table.

detail: 2/3 zone(s) lack DNSSEC: legacy.example.com, internal.example.com.
remediation: Enable DNSSEC on all public DNS zones.

detail: DB systems exist but no backups are configured; data is unprotected against loss.
remediation: Configure automated backups for all DB systems.

detail: Auto-scaling is disabled; the database cannot grow under load.
remediation: Enable auto-scaling on production ADBs.

detail: API Gateway has no OCI WAF policy attached; API traffic is not filtered for common web attacks.
remediation: Attach an OCI WAF policy (managed protection rules) to the API Gateway.

check_title: Public API Gateway without enforced TLS
detail: Public API Gateway endpoint does not enforce a TLS/HTTPS certificate; clients can fall back to plaintext.
remediation: Attach a TLS certificate to the gateway's public endpoint and redirect HTTP to HTTPS.
